name: findcheap-agent
description: Search Shopify Global Catalog and an approved Awin Feed, find verified deals, and monitor prices, promotions, and stock.

interface.shortDescription: Verified cards, pricing, coupons, and safe links.
interface.longDescription: FindCheap Agent is a Codex Plugin Agent. v0.8.0 exposes one product-search entrypoint that routes approved Awin affiliate products, Shopify Global Catalog, and an authorized zero-result Chrome fallback. Affiliate products must satisfy the same identity, condition, feature, availability, and price constraints; commission never affects routing or ranking. All qualifying sources use one product-card contract with explicit evidence, condition, merchant trust, price scope, and affiliate disclosure. Selected Shopify follow-ups reuse the exact prior renderId and variant identity. Watch rules bind to native Codex Automation. The agent never checks out, reserves inventory, purchases, or pays.
defaultPrompt: Search products, find verified deals, or create and bind a Watch to Codex Automation. Never launch MCP.
